Per-army color/theme values remain defined in each army's own .dc.html (Terran/Zerg/Protoss) and are not hardcoded into the shared stylesheet.
All existing pages (Command Center, Terran/Zerg/Protoss Army, Rules, Missions, UnitDetail) render with no visual regression versus the pre-change baseline commit (be1e49e).
The splash-intro localStorage fix is visually verified working (plays once, skipped on return trips) since the prior session could not confirm it.
The 'unit details appearing in the cards that extend' report is either reproduced and fixed, or confirmed as expected behavior / a viewing-setup red herring, with the reasoning recorded.
